--artifact.help: (Optional) Name of the specific artifact function to test.

--artifact_paths.help: Generate a text file list of artifact paths. This argument is meant to be used alone, without any other arguments.

--base-ref.help: commit to compare against, normally the merge base

--case.help: Case number for the test data

--create_profile_casedata.help: Generate an iLEAPP Profile file (.ilprofile) or LEAPP Case Data file (.lcasedata) into the specified path. This argument is meant to be used alone, without any other arguments.

--csv-to-md.help: Only convert CSV to Markdown summary

--custom_artifacts_path.help: Additional path to load artifacts from (e.g., scripts/alternate_artifacts)

--custom_output_folder.help: Custom name for the output folder

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--image.help: Name of the image from the manifest

--image-prompt.help: Prompt for image selection from the manifest

--input.help: Path to the input file (zip, tar, or tar.gz)

--itunes_password.help: Password used for encrypted iTunes backup

--keep.help: keep the --run output folder instead of deleting it

--keychain.help: Path to a keychain file captured from the device. Some apps keep their database key in the keychain, which is collected separately from the file system extraction.

--list.help: print every match, including allowlisted ones

--load_case_data.help: Path to LEAPP Case Data file (.lcasedata).

--local-repo.help: Path to local LAVA repo (relative to iLEAPP root)

--output_path.help: Path to base output folder (this must exist)

--platform.help: build to fetch; defaults to the platform this is run on

--root.help: scan this repository instead of the one this script lives in; BASELINE/ALLOWLIST still apply, so a sibling core reports its own findings as violations

--run.help: parse this corpus and compare produced rows to declared rows

--verbose.help: also report modules whose __artifacts_v2__ could not be read

--verify-hashes.help: re-hash every registered corpus; slow on large images

--wrap_text.help: Do not wrap text for output of data files

-t.help: Specify the input type. 'fs' for a folder containing extracted files with normal paths and names, 'tar', 'zip', or 'gz' for compressed packages containing files with normal names, 'itunes' for a folder containing a raw iTunes backup with hashed paths and names, 'file' for a single file input.
